title: Silicom 40G Dual-Port QSFP+ Intel® XL710-BM2 Chipset Ethernet Network Interface Card

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Silicom Intel® XL710-BM2 40G Dual-Port QSFP+ PCIe Network Interface Card

The Silicom Intel® XL710-BM2 40G Dual-Port QSFP+ Network Interface Card is a high-performance networking solution designed for enterprise servers, cloud environments, and high-speed data centers. Powered by the Intel® XL710-BM2 chipset, this adapter delivers ultra-low latency and high throughput with dual 40 Gigabit Ethernet ports, offering an aggregate bandwidth of up to 80 Gbps.

Key Features:

  • Dual 40GbE QSFP+ ports for ultra-fast data transfer
  • Intel® XL710-BM2 chipset for reliable performance and low CPU overhead
  • PCI Express 3.0 x8 interface ensures seamless integration and bandwidth efficiency
  • Low-profile form factor suitable for compact server environments
  • Advanced virtualization support including SR-IOV and VMDq
  • Broad OS compatibility: supports Windows, Linux, VMware, FreeBSD

Specifications:

  • Ports: 2 x QSFP+
  • Interface: PCIe Gen3 x8
  • Chipset: Intel® XL710-BM2
  • Form Factor: Low Profile
  • Power Consumption: Approx. 25W
  • Operating Temperature: 0°C to 55°C
  • Humidity: 0% to 90%, non-condensing
